mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_publication p JOIN kb_collaboration_event e ON e.event_id = p.event_id AND e.doc_id = p.document_id AND e.version_id = p.version_id JOIN kb_document_version v ON v.id = p.version_id AND v.doc_id = p.document_id JOIN kb_knowledge_order k ON k.singleton WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.kind = 'VERSION_PUBLISHED' AND k.protocol_version = 1 AND v.publication_evidence = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.published_at = p.published_at AND e.occurred_at = p.published_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_match_projection SET status = 'WAITING_SOURCE', error_class = 'SOURCE_NOT_READY', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{delay}), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE event_id = #{claim.id} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{claim.token} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_match_projection(event_id) SELECT p.event_id FROM kb_knowledge_publication p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_match_projection m WHERE m.event_id = p.event_id) ORDER BY p.position LIMIT #{limit} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE kb_knowledge_match_projection m SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), claim_token = m.claim_token + 1, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM (SELECT event_id, lease_owner IS NOT NULL AS takeover FROM kb_knowledge_match_projection WHERE status <> 'DONE' AND next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) c WHERE m.event_id = c.event_id RETURNING m.event_id AS id, NULL::date AS week_start, m.claim_token AS token, m.recipient_cursor, m.attempts, c.takeover
mapper.sql: FROM kb_knowledge_publication p JOIN kb_knowledge_subscription s ON ((s.kind = 'DOCUMENT' AND s.target_id = p.document_id) OR (s.kind = 'SPACE' AND s.target_id = p.space_id) OR (s.kind = 'TAG' AND s.target_id = ANY(p.tag_ids))) JOIN kb_knowledge_subscription_period g ON g.subscription_id = s.id AND g.user_id = s.user_id WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} AND g.start_position < p.position AND (g.end_position IS NULL OR g.end_position > p.position)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id AND s.user_id > #{after} ORDER BY s.user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id, g.id AS generation_id, COALESCE((SELECT r.mode FROM kb_knowledge_preference_revision r WHERE r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.position < p.position ORDER BY r.position DESC LIMIT 1), 'WEEKLY') AS mode, p.week_start AND
s.user_id IN #{user}
FALSE
ORDER BY s.user_id, g.id

WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_update(id, user_id, event_id, mode, week_start) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{eventId}, #{mode}, #{weekStart}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) SELECT id FROM inserted UNION ALL SELECT id FROM kb_knowledge_update WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_update_match(update_id, user_id, generation_id) VALUES (#{updateId}, #{userId}, #{generationId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_delivery(id, user_id, kind, update_id) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), #{userId}, 'PER_PUBLICATION', #{updateId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_match_projection SET recipient_cursor = #{cursor}, status = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'PENDING' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END, lease_owner = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN NULL ELSE #{owner} END, lease_until = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}) END, error_class = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE event_id = #{claim.id} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{claim.token} AND status = 'PENDING' AND recipient_cursor <= #{cursor}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT max(week_start) + 7 FROM kb_knowledge_week), kb_knowledge_week_start(coverage_at)) FROM kb_knowledge_order WHERE singleton
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_week(week_start, due_at, close_position, status) SELECT #{week}, ((CAST(#{week} AS date) + 7)::timestamp + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', #{position}, 'WAITING_MATCHES' WHERE #{at} >= (((CAST(#{week} AS date) + 7)::timestamp + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE kb_knowledge_week w SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), claim_token = w.claim_token + 1 FROM (SELECT week_start, lease_owner IS NOT NULL AS takeover FROM kb_knowledge_week WHERE status <> 'DONE' AND next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND due_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY week_start LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) c WHERE w.week_start = c.week_start RETURNING NULL::uuid AS id, w.week_start, w.claim_token AS token, w.recipient_cursor, w.attempts, c.takeover

SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_publication p JOIN kb_knowledge_week w ON w.week_start = p.week_start LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_match_projection m ON m.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.week_start = #{week} AND (p.position > w.close_position OR m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'DONE'))
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM kb_knowledge_update WHERE week_start = #{week} AND mode = 'WEEKLY' AND user_id > #{after} ORDER BY user_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_delivery(id, user_id, kind, week_start) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), #{userId}, 'WEEKLY', #{week}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_week SET recipient_cursor = #{cursor}, status = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'READY' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END, lease_owner = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN NULL ELSE #{owner} END, lease_until = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}) END, error_class = NULL WHERE week_start = #{claim.weekStart} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{claim.token} AND status <> 'DONE' AND recipient_cursor <= #{cursor}
mapper.select: UPDATE kb_knowledge_delivery d SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), claim_token = d.claim_token + 1 FROM (SELECT k.id, k.lease_owner IS NOT NULL AS takeover FROM kb_knowledge_delivery k WHERE k.status = 'PENDING' AND k.next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (k.lease_until IS NULL OR k.lease_until < clock_timestamp()) AND (k.kind = 'WEEKLY' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_update u JOIN kb_knowledge_match_projection p ON p.event_id = u.event_id WHERE u.id = k.update_id AND p.status = 'DONE')) ORDER BY k.next_attempt_at, k.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF k SKIP LOCKED) c WHERE d.id = c.id RETURNING d.id, d.week_start, d.claim_token AS token, 0::bigint AS recipient_cursor, d.attempts, c.takeover
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_delivery SET status = CASE WHEN #{notified} THEN 'NOTIFIED' ELSE 'NO_ELIGIBLE' END, dispatch_position = #{position}, dispatched_at = #{at}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_class = NULL WHERE id = #{claim.id} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{claim.token} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_user_notification(notification_id, recipient_user_id, type, knowledge_delivery_id) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), #{userId}, CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'WEEKLY' THEN 'KNOWLEDGE_WEEKLY_DIGEST' ELSE 'SUBSCRIBED_VERSION_PUBLISHED' END, #{id}) ON CONFLICT (knowledge_delivery_id, recipient_user_id) DO NOTHING

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'match') AS matching, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'weekly') AS weekly, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'delivery') AS delivery, GREATEST(COALESCE(floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - min(at)))::bigint, 0), 0) AS oldest_seconds, clock_timestamp() AS sampled_at FROM ( SELECT 'match' AS stage, p.published_at AS at FROM kb_knowledge_publication p LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_match_projection m ON m.event_id = p.event_id WHERE m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'DONE' UNION ALL SELECT 'weekly', due_at FROM kb_knowledge_week WHERE status <> 'DONE' UNION ALL SELECT 'delivery', created_at FROM kb_knowledge_delivery WHERE status = 'PENDING' ) work
